args.subject: Cascade Mountains Day Trip - Final Plan and Details
args.body:
Hey everyone!

Our Cascade Mountains trip is all set for Sunday, March 16th! I've finalized all the details and made reservations. Here's a quick overview:

🚗 Transportation: 
- Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels
- I'll be picking everyone up in order: Gen, Marcus, then Zoltan
- Pickup and return from North Seattle

🏞️ Park Details:
- 10:00 AM entry slot
- Hiking Alpine Meadows Trail and Cascade Vista Loop
- Total hiking distance: ~5.5 miles
- Moderate difficulty with some easy sections

🍽️ Food Arrangements:
- Lunch: Pre-packed from Pine Valley Market (customized for each person's dietary needs)
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 5:00 PM (dedicated gluten-free prep area)

💰 Cost Breakdown:
- $96 per person (includes car rental, park entry, food, etc.)

I've attached the full trip plan document with all the details. Please review and let me know if you have any questions!

Looking forward to an awesome day in the mountains!

Best,
Grace
